objective: Test whether the S&P direction receiving greater next-minute quote impact from timestamp-verified aggressor events across both inverse leveraged wrappers persists through the afternoon.

signal.response_window: Each event's current BBO minute to the next BBO minute, ending no later than 10:14
signal.freshness: Count a last trade only when A/B side is present and ts_event lies inside its own one-minute BBO interval.
signal.projection: UPRO aggressor and midpoint-return signs map through +3; SPXU maps through -3.
signal.cell_impact: Mean of projected trade sign multiplied by next-minute projected midpoint log return.
signal.wrapper_weighting: Compute bullish and bearish cell impact within each wrapper, then average UPRO and SPXU equally.
signal.score: Equal-wrapper bullish impact minus equal-wrapper bearish impact.
signal.minimum_data: At least three fresh events in every wrapper-by-underlying-direction cell.
signal.decision: Positive buys UPRO, negative buys SPXU, exact zero holds cash.
signal.filters: No price, magnitude, volatility, weekday, or regime filter.

data.independent_feed_rebuild: Databento EQUS.MINI UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m, available from 2023-03-28
data.extension: 2026 ARCX.PILLAR, opened only after a full development pass

development.holdout_lock: No 2024-2026 post-signal returns unless every development gate passes.
gates: at least two trades per week
positive fixed-$100 P&L in 2021, 2022, and 2023 separately
positive UPRO and SPXU P&L separately
compounded ending cash above price-only SPY
positive after one extra cent per share at both fills
positive after a five-minute entry delay
positive after removing the ten best sessions
outperform the raw projected aggressor-count placebo
positive UPRO and SPXU P&L separately
positive after removing five best sessions

placebos.sign_flipped: Trade the opposite wrapper from the frozen impact score.
placebos.raw_aggressor_count: Ignore quote response and trade the sign of all fresh projected aggressor events.

prohibited_repairs: change entry, exit, or add a stop
